title: Sa302SettlementResult
description: 1.0.0 (2026-09-10): the 200 body of POST /api/sa302. PROPOSAL ONLY, same scope boundary as the request schema beside it — not referenced by any compatibility manifest; that reference and its ratification are the owner's separate step. || Derived and cross-verified 2026-09-10 from tax-calc-engine FirstLot.TaxCalcEngine.Api/Controllers/Sa302SettlementController.cs (the anonymous Ok(...) body) against firstlot-suite src/lib/filing/calculation.ts (`Sa302SettlementEnvelope` and the SA110 box mapping that consumes it). The envelope has eleven members and the TS type declares six; the five it omits (specials, exclusions, specialsEvaluated, exclusionsEvaluated, claimBoundary) are stated by the engine and simply not read by that consumer, so they are required here — this describes the wire, not one reader of it. || `income` is deliberately UNPINNED and is NOT the governed result's shape: EnvelopeResultJson.ToSa302IncomeShape is a strict SUPERSET of it (62 keys on the live body against the governed schema's 28), so $ref-ing stateless-calculation-result's incomeTaxResult — which is additionalProperties:false — would refuse the real body. Pinning it needs its own schema and is not attempted here; the one member a consumer reads today is pensionCharges (firstlot-suite SA110 CAL6). || WHAT A CONSUMER MUST PIN: sa302ArithmeticDigest, not incomeArithmeticDigest and not engineVersion. The income digest is blind to the composer — HMRC corpus case 2025-26/253 changed production composer arithmetic while the income digest did not move — so pinning it would verify the income spine while believing it verified the composed settlement.

sa302.description: The composed settlement's intermediate lines, not just the headline — the review point that the composition must record intermediate outputs separately. combinedTotal is c12.18 and is SIGNED: negative is a repayment, and the corpus contains real negative cases. SA110 CAL1 takes max(0, combinedTotal) and CAL2 takes max(0, -combinedTotal); a consumer that reads only CAL1 silently drops every repayment case.

income.description: The income spine underneath the composition (EnvelopeResultJson.ToSa302IncomeShape). Deliberately unpinned — see the top-level description: it is a superset of the governed result, not the same shape, so this schema states its presence and not its members. `income: {}` validates today, which is the honest limit of an outer-envelope contract rather than a claim about the projection.

sa302ArithmeticDigest.description: The COMPOSED settlement's arithmetic identity. This is the one a consumer pins.

incomeArithmeticDigest.description: The governed 12-field income digest. Blind to the composer — see the description above before pinning this.

specials.description: Always null, and null rather than [] on purpose: an empty array reads as 'none apply', which would be fake completeness. Pair it with specialsEvaluated.

exclusions.description: Always null, for the same reason as specials.

specialsEvaluated.description: Always false: this engine does not evaluate HMRC specials.

exclusionsEvaluated.description: Always false: this engine does not evaluate HMRC exclusions.

claimBoundary.description: Stated in every response so no consumer can mistake this route for the pinned governed surface.

governedRulesetLabelApplies.description: Always false. This route serves current arithmetic over a wider surface than the frozen tax-calc-engine/2025-26@0.9.5 label covers, so it cannot carry it.

cgtLegSupplied.description: Whether the request carried a cgt leg. False means the composed total is income-only, which for a filer with gains is a materially different figure.
